title: A weather line
description:
Build a forecast line from small functions that each do one thing:

```python
def to_fahrenheit(celsius): ...       # celsius * 9 / 5 + 32
def describe(celsius): ...            # "freezing" (<= 0), "cold" (< 15), "mild" (< 25), "hot" otherwise
def forecast_line(day, celsius): ...  # "Mon: 18.0°C / 64.4°F (mild)": one decimal for both temperatures
```

`forecast_line` must use the other two functions.
hints: `f"{value:.1f}"` rounds to one decimal place; call `to_fahrenheit` and `describe` inside the f-string.
